messages:
maya: Quick draft of RN + short plan. Need quick thumbs before I push the PR. Also decision needed on staging->prod cutover time and pining runtime.

sam: on it, will scan the draft now. canary at 5% to start?

liam: +1 5% for 30m, then evaluate. Rollback trigger we should use: 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m OR p95 latency > 300ms.

maya: updated draft below — paste into RN doc if this looks right:
```release-notes
- Fix: reduce cold-start latency for batch inference (~35%)
- Feature: regional canary routing to improve tail latency
- Ops: pin serving runtime to rlt-2026-03-15 to avoid recent regression
- Note: metrics and traces linked in playbook (see infra runbook)
```

anna: small copy nit: "regional canary routing" reads better than "canary routing by region". Also add a line about rollback contact (oncall).

deploy-bot: deploy queued: release/2026-03-15-rlt. Pin applied: rlt-2026-03-15. Canary schedule configured: 5% -> 20% @30m -> 100% @2h. Job id: job-7721. Use `/deploy status job-7721` to follow.

maya: plan summary: staging cutover window 00:15-01:15 UTC, prod rollout 01:30-03:30 UTC (canary -> ramp). @oncall-sara please confirm standby and rollback ownership.

oncall-sara: I got this. I'll be on-call/standby 01:00-04:00 UTC. I'll monitor error budget and traces. If 5xx > 0.5% for 10m I'll initiate rollback. Ping me in #incidents if it looks bad.

liam: I'll add concise rollback steps to the playbook now: 1) pin back to rlt-2026-03-08, 2) stop canary job, 3) revert routing rules, 4) open incident if >2 services impacted. Keep it short for ops.

maya: excellent. final check: do we want to include a short SWAT matrix in the internal announce? (risk / mitigation / who)

sam: yes, please. three lines max. risk: API error spike. mitigation: immediate rollback + pin. who: @oncall-sara + infra rotation.

anna: :thumbsup:

maya: posting internal announce at T-45m with RN link + playbook + canary schedule. Confluence link: https://redwood.example/confluence/rn/2026-03-15-rlt-cutover (will update after PR merge).

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: deploy window opens at 5112349200. Canary monitor set for job-7721. Alerts: high-5xx, high-p95.

maya: thanks — unless anyone objects I'll pin runtime and start canary at window open. Closing thread, moving to PR comments for minor copy edits.
metadata_notes: Thread: RN drafting + internal announce coordination for staging cutover and rollout. Short, ops-focused messages with deploy-bot confirmations and explicit rollback criteria.
